known_issues: Signature drawing is hard to see due to dark background
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Favicon icon illustration of a falcon with the letters “ID”, gothic/high-tech styling, transparent or clean solid background (falcon-ids-favicon-gothic.dim_32x32.webp)
- Apple touch icon illustration of a falcon with the letters “ID”, gothic/high-tech styling, centered composition (falcon-ids-apple-touch-gothic.dim_180x180.webp)

existing_features.title: Improve the signature pad so users can clearly see the signature while drawing even when the site is in dark mode (dark background). Update the signature canvas styling and drawing configuration to ensure strong contrast between the canvas background and the ink color in both light and dark themes.

Fix signature pad canvas rendering issues related to sizing and clearing so that the drawn signature is not distorted/blurry and the clear action fully resets the drawing surface. Ensure canvas sizing accounts for devicePixelRatio correctly and that clearing resets the canvas to the intended background.

Generate a site favicon and apple touch icon featuring a falcon with the letters “ID”, matching the existing site theme, and ensure the app uses these icons via the existing <link rel="icon"> and <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> tags in frontend/index.html.

Audit the project for other errors/issues that could cause build or deployment failures (including missing assets referenced by the frontend and runtime errors), and fix the issues found so the app builds cleanly.

new_feature_requests.summary: Improve signature pad visibility on dark background so users can clearly see what they are drawing
